name_reason: Name already conforms: data_fd2_ (game global) + ui_ domain (UI menu) + slide_bg_snapshot (slide-transition background snapshot) + buf_ptr (reflects the data type: a pointer slot holding the buffer). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Evidence: writers in fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in/fd2_save_slot_selector_ui/promote.c openers do `slot = malloc(64000)` then `memmove(slot, 0xA0000, 64000)` (snapshot of the 64000-byte mode-13h VGA framebuffer); readers pass it as the bg-restore arg to fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step / fd2_slide_panel_down_step.
purpose: Pointer slot holding a malloc(64000) pristine 320x200 (mode 13h) background snapshot captured from VGA (0xA0000) at the start of each menu slide-in/out transition; used to restore the backdrop between animation frames.
logic_summary: BSS pointer (rests at 0). Each UI menu opener (status / portrait / shop / promote / revive / save-slot / spell-select / chapter-intro / recruitment) assigns it via (uint32)malloc(64000), immediately fills it with memmove(buf, 0xA0000, 64000) to snapshot the current VGA framebuffer, then uses it as the backdrop-restore source between slide-animation frames and (in the revive menu) as the surface for the money-panel redraw. Freed on close via the shared close routine. Part of the shared 3-buffer slide-transition state with data_fd2_ui_slide_anim_accumulator_buf_ptr (0x53C5B) and data_fd2_ui_slide_composed_target_buf_ptr (0x53C63).
datatype: undefined4 (uint32) -- a 4-byte pointer slot holding a void* to a 64000-byte heap buffer (Ghidra: undefined4, len=4; src: uint32)
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer slot (not an array). Value = address of a malloc(64000) buffer holding a 320x200x8bpp (mode 13h) screen image == background snapshot; 0 at rest (BSS, never statically initialized).
notes: Ghidra plate was null (blank) for this data address; created a concise PLATE_COMMENT (via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...)) reflecting the src conclusion, then save_program() succeeded. src comment block (promote.c lines ~1066-1072) was already accurate/concise/ASCII (allowed @0x53C5F address annotation) and matches all evidence -> kept unchanged, so no edit to promote.c. Verified semantics across 3 independent flows: fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in @0x17e35, fd2_save_slot_selector_ui @0x305a8, and the promote.c openers; read_memory @0x53c5f = all zeros (confirms BSS at-rest 0).
